⚠️ **Do not paste exploit details or credentials in this issue.**

Please use the private path instead — see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md):
- GitHub private security advisory (Security → Advisories → New draft), or
- email the maintainers directly.

If you must open an issue, describe only the affected area (e.g. "auth",
"pay notify", "multi-tenancy") without reproduction steps, and we will contact you.
